concepts.summary: The base keeper from a two by two look off the Randall or Lamar midzone fake. To the keep side there is a low cross at 10 to 12 yards and a high corner at 18 to 20 yards, the back leaks late to the flat, and the backside receiver works an outside release runback. The Sift tag sends the tight end across the backside.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 sit on the low cross, the corner and the late flat. Best read: 1 low cross, 2 high corner, 3 late down flat. The exact order is unclear in the extracted text.
concepts.qb: Fake the midzone, get depth and run to the keep side. Far corner is an alert.
concepts.hb: Sell the run, then come late to the flat.

positions.Z: High corner at 18 to 20 yards. A far corner alert is drawn on the pictures.
positions.X: Backside runback: outside release to 20 yards and come back to 15. Against cloud, sit on the sideline at 15.

alerts: Far corner alert on the deep route.
Backside runback sits on the sideline at 15 yards against cloud.

concepts.summary: The same keeper with the Skate tag, which turns the line into a slide away from the keep. The routes stay the same: low cross at 10 to 12, high corner at 18 to 20, late flat from the back, runback on the backside. Pin replaces Sift and has the F pin the edge instead of sifting.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the low cross, corner and late flat. Best read: 1 low cross, 2 high corner, 3 late down flat. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Get depth and run to the keep side.

positions.OL: Slide (Skate) away from the keep side.
positions.X: Backside runback: outside release, 20 yards, back to 15. Sit on the sideline at 15 against cloud.
positions.F: Sift across the backside, or Pin the edge when Pin is called.

concepts.summary: Keeper with the Husker tag: the deep route becomes a Husker corner at 12 yards with a me/you call between the two receivers on that side. The low cross at 10 to 12 and the late down flat stay the same. Skate adds the line slide.
concepts.progression: Best read: 1 low cross, 2 Husker corner, 3 down flat. Order unclear in the text.

positions.X: Low cross at 10 to 12 yards. Far corner alert.
positions.Z: Husker corner at 12 yards, me/you call with the inside receiver.
positions.F: Slide side player on the Skate version.

alerts: Me/you call on the Husker corner.

concepts.summary: Keeper with Fly motion across the formation, so the QB reverses out instead of opening to the fake. Routes: low cross at 10 to 12, high corner at 18 to 20, flat, line slide. The backside receiver keeps the runback. H Sneak has the back sneak out late instead of a normal flat.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the low cross, corner and flat. Best read: 1 low cross, 2 high corner, 3 flat. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Reverse out with the Fly motion, then get depth and run.
concepts.hb: Flat. With H Sneak, hold and sneak out late.

positions.X: High corner at 18 to 20 yards, or the backside runback (sit on the sideline at 15 against cloud) depending on the picture.
positions.F: Sift the backside, or Pin on the Pin version.

formations: [11] Y MO SOUTH RT CLAMP F SHORT

concepts.summary: Fluster combines the Fly motion with the Husker corner at 12 yards. The low cross at 10 to 12, the flat and the line slide stay. The QB reverses out. Oscar is a tag attached on the Solo Rt Ace version; the page does not define it.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the cross, the Husker corner and the flat. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Reverse out, get depth and run.
concepts.hb: Flat, or Sneak late when H Sneak is called.

concepts.summary: Keeper from a bunch. The bunch gives a low cross at 10 to 12, a down flat and a late down flat, and a deep route that is a high corner at 18 to 20 in the base version or a Husker corner at 12 with a me/you call. Slacker adds a 5 yard slack route under the Husker corner.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the low cross, the flats and the corner. Best read: 1 low cross, 2 down flat, 3 corner. Order unclear in the text.

positions.Z: Down flat on the base version. Slack route at 5 yards on Slacker.
positions.X: High corner at 18 to 20 yards, or Husker corner at 12 with the me/you call.

concepts.summary: Bunch keeper with Fly motion, so the QB reverses out. The bunch runs a low cross, a flat and a late down flat, with a high corner at 18 to 20 or a Husker corner at 12. X Slalom is a route tag for the single receiver on the Husker version.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the flat, the cross and the corner. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Reverse out, get depth and run.

positions.Y: Fly motion across the formation, then low cross.
positions.Z: Fly on the Husker version, or the corner.
positions.X: High corner at 18 to 20, or the Slalom route with the me/you Husker corner.

concepts.summary: Keeper from a spread trips look. The trips side runs a low cross, an extended down flat at 5 yards and a late down flat; the single receiver runs the backside runback. The Smash tag turns the outside two into a 6 yard hitch and a corner at 12.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the low cross, the flats and the backside runback. Order unclear in the text.
concepts.qb: Get depth and run. From gun on the Smash version.

positions.Y: Low cross at 10 to 12, or the corner at 12 on Smash.
positions.Z: Extended down flat at 5 yards, or the 6 yard hitch on Smash.
positions.X: Backside runback: outside release, 20 yards, back to 15. Sit on the sideline at 15 against cloud.

concepts.summary: Keeper off the tite zone fake instead of midzone. The F slams the edge and then inserts to a corner at 12 yards, which is the first read. The Y runs the low cross at 10 to 12, the back goes to the flat, and the outside receiver has a far corner alert.
concepts.progression: 1 insert corner by F after the slam, 2 low cross, 3 flat.
concepts.qb: Get depth and run. Far corner is an alert.

positions.F: Slam the edge, then insert corner at 12 yards.

alerts: Far corner alert on the outside receiver.

concepts.summary: The tite zone keeper with Flock motion. The Z flies across and runs a go, the F slams and inserts to the corner at 12, the Y runs the low cross, the back goes to the flat.
concepts.progression: 1 insert corner by F, 2 low cross, 3 flat.

positions.F: Slam, then insert corner at 12 yards.

concepts.summary: The tite zone keeper with Fly motion from a three by one look. The F flies across, the Z slams and inserts to the corner at 12, the Y runs the low cross, the back goes to the flat.
concepts.progression: 1 insert corner by Z, 2 low cross, 3 flat.

positions.Z: Slam, then insert corner at 12 yards.

concepts.summary: Not on the index. Keeper with the T tag, which pulls the playside tackle into the alley (see the Randall-Lamar protection page). One blocker stays in for one count (1 block) before the routes develop. Routes: low cross at 10 to 12, high corner at 18 to 20, late down flat from the back.
concepts.progression: Numbers 1 to 3 on the low cross, the corner and the flat. Order unclear in the text.

positions.OL: Playside tackle pulls to the alley on the T call.
positions.F: Block for one count, then release (1 block).
